title: pouzolzia sanguinea var. formosana
intro: Pouzolzia sanguinea var. formosana, commonly known as Taiwanese Red Vine or Formosan Red Vine, is a plant species in the family Urticaceae. It is traditionally used in Taiwanese medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and skin conditions, due to its reported health benefits of reducing pain and improving circulation. The therapeutic actions of Pouzolzia sanguinea var. formosana include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and analgesic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Pouzolzia sanguinea var. formosana for medicinal purposes.
